## Summary

Describe the user-visible and security-relevant behavior changed by this pull request.

## Validation

- [ ] Backend tests pass on a supported Python version.
- [ ] Frontend tests and syntax checks pass.
- [ ] Ruff lint and format checks pass.
- [ ] New behavior and failure modes have tests.
- [ ] Public API, configuration, compatibility, and security documentation is updated.
- [ ] No credentials, signed tokens, production paths, or private workflows are included.

## Security review

Explain any effect on authentication, CSRF, provider requests, redirects, filesystem paths, capacity accounting, checksums, publication, logging, or secret handling. Write “None” only when none of these boundaries is touched.
